name: org.realitydeslab.echovision
description:
EchoVision is a mixed reality art experience simulating bat echolocation: users' voices are visually represented in the surrounding environment. Built on the HoloKit Unity SDK for iPhones with a LiDAR camera (Mono and HoloKit Stereo) and for Apple Vision Pro.

Contains the app's scripts, scenes, VFX, materials, audio mixer and tests.
